answer: Proof of Agent resists Sybil attacks by bonding collateral to each identity and linking equivocation evidence across keys: when k identities coordinate conflicting attestations, aggregate penalties grow as O(k^2), while detection applies an exponential multiplier to capital loss through asymmetric depreciation and escrow seizure. Thus, a swarm cannot hide behind cheap aliases; even a haven, cedar, or pearl cluster becomes economically untenable.
